Freeface projection does not automatically allow allits vertices to move: each vertex is checked against allits incident actual upward occupiedsupportfaces, including faces outside the primary ring.
House/road support is actual9foundation+922paving union; no12m/28mfade, layoutpad,2mtree disk or wholeface surrogate added. Tree/Worldoverlay/newmeshselfintersection remain separate candidatechecks.
